title: mock-theta-census: a numerical census of Ramanujan-style q-series and the sign-twisted fifth-order functions ψ₀*, ψ₁*
description:
A computational search for Ramanujan-style mock theta functions. A classifier based on radial asymptotics at 19 roots of unity (Arb ball arithmetic) sorts q-series into modular, mock, quantum-type and neither, and classifies the known functions of a 51-function validation catalog correctly (the one exception, a sum of two modular forms with different offsets, is a documented limitation). A census of 8,869 distinct Eulerian series finds 25 mock theta functions, all identified: 23 are known functions, rescalings or specializations of the universal mock theta function g₂, and two are half a fifth-order function plus half of a sign-twisted companion.

The companions ψ₁*(q) = Σ (−1)ⁿ q^{n(n+1)/2} (−q;q)ₙ and ψ₀*(q) = Σ (−1)ⁿ q^{(n+1)(n+2)/2} (−q;q)ₙ satisfy 2ψ₀* = f₀* − θ₄·R₀ and 2ψ₁* = f₁* + θ₄·R₁, with R₀, R₁ the entire Rogers–Ramanujan function at a = 1, q (OEIS A039924, A224898). Their expansion at q = −1 has integer coefficients whose large-order behaviour is governed by R₀, R₁ (constants in ℚ(√5)); radial limits at odd-order roots equal one third of the first period (proof sketch in v1.4). Proof status of every claim is marked in the documents.

Version 1.2 adds sign twists of all catalog mock theta functions (bounded, non-trivial companions also for the fifth-order F₀, F₁ and the eighth-order T₀; the twist of the third-order ψ turned out to be the known −σ*/2 of Andrews–Dyson–Hickerson) and a rank-2 census of 6,327 double sums. Its one mock-theta-like candidate, D(q) = Σ q^{m²−mn+n²}/((−q;q)ₘ(−q;q)ₙ), grows like the third-order f(q) and has golden-ratio asymptotics at q = 1. Version 1.3 adds a proved identity explaining it: D = θ₄·f + 4R with R = Σ_{d>k≥0} (−1)^{d+k+1} q^{d²}/(−q;q)ₖ a sum of theta tails, and a general-z identity for the family Σ q^{m²−mn+n²}/((zq)ₘ(q/z)ₙ).

Version 1.4 describes the structure of ψ₀*, ψ₁*. Under x ↦ 1/x they do not go to themselves but to a new finite sum W(ξ) = Σ (−1)ʲ ξ^{j²+j} (ξ;ξ²)ⱼ at the dual root of unity: ψ₁*(e^{2πi/X}) = C̄·t^{−1/2}·e^{−S̄/t}·W(e^{−πiX})·(1 + O(t)) + O(1) with t = −2πi/X and S̄ = π²/3 + i·Cl₂(π/3) (verified on 56 residue classes to 6·10⁻²¹ and checked independently). This is quantum modularity of Kashaev-invariant (Garoufalidis–Zagier) type; the growth rate 2·Cl₂(π/3) is the volume of the figure-eight knot complement. Also new: bilateral identities of the same shape for F₀*, F₁* (proved), resurgence of ψ* at q = i and q → 1, a scan of F(z), g₂ and g₃ at all roots of unity of order ≤ 12 with a dilogarithm saddle-point threshold for F(z), a Hecke-type sparsity test of the bounded twists, and a q → 1/q duality search over the census. None of ψ*, the identities or W was found in the literature checked so far.

Includes code, data, a formula sheet in several notations, a rank-2 (double-sum) census pipeline, and interactive pages (https://quasimondo.github.io/mock-theta-census/). Code: MIT. Data and documents: CC BY 4.0.

Made by Mario Klingemann with extensive assistance from AI models (Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.2), which wrote most of the code, analysis and proofs under his direction; see the README section 'How this was made'.
